module_summary: Traffic-light phase timer: a down-counter reloaded with per-phase durations on detected light falling edges, shortened by a pedestrian request during green.

anchors.name: ticks
anchors.why: Down-counter output, reloaded with phase duration on light transitions, decremented otherwise.

anchors.name: cut_short
anchors.why: Pedestrian request during long green; reloads counter with short value, top priority.

anchors.name: g_fall
anchors.why: Representative light falling-edge detect; selects reload duration for next phase.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: Edge detectors and pedestrian override select reload value of the countdown timer.
